  "text": "Drift detection and durable correction are separate responsibilities. `project_change_consistency` compares release diffs/changelog declarations with PROJECT_* authorities; Context Plane compares canonical source revisions with advisory evidence; Project Context Health inspects initialization, authority/module size, missing sources, unindexed `.mssr/knowledge/`, and old MSSR artifacts; `skill_route_audit` and structural Skill Health inspect routing and capability/reference debt. `evaluateMssrProjectKnowledgeMaintenance` combines bounded observable metadata from any host — trace stage, changed paths/tool categories, package/runtime adoption, routing/skill-structure changes, project initialization/health, freshness conflicts and user corrections — into `NONE`/`WATCH`/`REVIEW`/`REQUIRED` targets. These detectors produce evidence only. `WATCH` does not force extra context; `REVIEW`/`REQUIRED` activates maintenance, where `skill-maintenance-loop` chooses the canonical target (`AGENTS.md`, PROJECT_*, an indexed knowledge module, owning skill/reference, routing/fixture, or local documentation) and verifies the resulting diff. Reviewed durable statements may be normalized by `planMssrProjectKnowledgeCapture`, but the host owns the explicit write/manifest transaction. No detector silently writes the owner it is auditing.",
